    Pl. IManifesto

    It is a way of working. And it has been going on for generations, with nobody watching.

    The grower holds a standard nobody pays for.

    You decide where your money goes, with nobody watching.

    Same habit.

    That is why this is a club, not a subscription.

    Texto tomado del pitch (láminas «Not a bean» y «Same habit»). «He» se cambió por «The grower» porque el primer lote es de Ana María.
